name: ru.tinkoff.acquiring.sdk.cardscanners.ui.AsdkNfcScanActivity
description: The Tinkoff Acquiring SDK opens this Activity when the shopper chooses to read a bank card by NFC. It reads the card number and expiration date and returns them to the card form.
disableEffect: The SDK's NFC card-reading option will not work, so shoppers cannot fill those card details by tapping a compatible card.
